test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, “ABILITY” is written as “BDLLITY”, and “CONDUCT” is written as “DQQDUCT”. How will “DISPLAY” be written in that language?
solution:
Here, the alphabets and their positions are shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e866fb782fb27697540c09e531348bb0b91b712d7084656a2f4281c6c2000f58.png] 

“ABILITY” is written as “BDLLITY” 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e6ab73ef1774d7e06044e426d439197fc68ad5615b57d209f4e5c1f4e390c87.png] 

And,

“CONDUCT” is written as “DQQDUCT”

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32e947b3859f5f4ac78ee3e82058fd2a7246465e335e47040a15fb527d9126b6.png] 

Similarly,

“DISPLAY” be written

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7e2360a00f4665af67a160fb6ae681e095d5bdeff44785b02d9292e123148df.png] 

Hence, the code language is '**__EKVPLAY__**' for the given word.
